description: Resolves the contradiction between r-txn-1b/wsclose-* (after Workspace.Close, Database.Name and recordset fields answer 3420) and r-def-cat-txn/cat-workspace-close-held-objects (they still answer). Variants on created Workspaces, each holding a Database, a dynaset, a TableDef and a temporary QueryDef: (1) Workspace.Close with no transaction; (2) with BeginTrans and an update (then a fresh Workspace reads the row); (3) Database.Close with no transaction, Workspace kept. After each, Workspaces.Count and each held object (Database.Name, RecordCount and a field read, TableDef.Name, QueryDef.SQL, Workspace.Name) are probed, Errors before/after. Asks whether the transaction, the Close target or the Workspace kind decides what stays usable.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
